nom: Amazon Basics Original Clean Astringent Skin Cleanser

avis.texte: Astringent seems good. It reminds me of sea breeze. My face felt tingly and fresh. The bottle and cap, however, are bad. The bottle leaks a lot everytime you tip it. I tried tightening the cap but it still leaks. I will have to make sure it doesn't accidentally fall over or it will dribble. I will have to fully remove cap to use with cotton pad. If I use flip top it dribbles down the sides of the bottle.
This is a good face cleanser, and I've been using it every night. I will be ordering it again.

So far so good, my only complaint so far is that it smells like mouthwash is on my face. I don't like the smell. I've tried it a couple times because I couldn't get rid of these bubble bumps on my face. I think because Astringent skin cleanser are alcohol based, that helped a bit. Face looks a bit better. I only use when needed.
Just as good as seabreeze (just as tingly, oil-busting, smells identical), less expensive. Plus, I like the color in the bottle better. Looks "fresher" sitting on my bathroom counter.
I will forever buy this astringent! Great price, smells good and keeps my face blemish free! I use it every morning and night and doesn't dry out my face at all. Good stuff, highly recommend!

avis.titre: One of the best values I found
avis.texte: This was one of the best values I came across, this is just the basic astringent which is what I needed so the price & quality meets my needs. Sadly, the product spilled during delivery/transportation and about 3-4 oz were missing. I really wish Amazon would seal their products to avoid spillage, as proof of new product & lack of contamination. Aside from that, I decided to keep the product and make good use of it, it does clean skin pretty well. The scent is a bit on the strong side but no complaints on my end as I’m used to it since I’ve been using astringent since my teens & works for me to keep my skin clean & clear from acne.
This product is a great value for the money, made of great quality and it works great at helping to tighten pores and reduce oiliness. I highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: If you use witch hazel on your face you gotta try this!
avis.texte: The value of this product is great! And it feels magnificent on your face after a wash.

Seems like it works fine, but unfortunately mine opened up in the box somehow and started leaking and I lost about a third of it. I'm not sure if maybe it got too hot and burst at some point in shipping or what, but I'm disappointed it arrived in this state. I would have reached out for a partial refund or something, but Amazon seemed to only want to do a return and I really don't feel like shipping a $3 product back to them. So it works good, but just know it may not last through the shipping process.

Product was not properly packaged. The bottle leaked on to the other products. Fortunately the other products were not susceptible to liquid damage. Updating review after initial disappointment. Very similar to Sea Breeze which I have used for years. I like the smell and the feeling on my face.

avis.titre: So refreshing!! Great for my normal skin
avis.texte: Its smells so good. I love eucalyptus fragrance. It is not too oily perfect for my skin. I have a regular skin, so it works for me. The only think probably is little hard is the alcohol, because it little strong for my eyes, so I need to close them when I apply it. But it feel so refreshing so I dont care about the alcohol because I know it helps to make the skin aseptic, microbe free!
Bottle cap was loose, seal was broken and half the contents was gone by the time I got it in the mail today - brown wrapping paper was soaked

avis.titre: Made me break out and I'm in alot of pain
avis.texte: This astringent made me break out in pimples and hives so bad I had to go to hospital. Never in my life have I had anything like this. I am not allergic to anything, healthy as a horse, and have always used astringent during the day at work after lunch when I brush my teeth and refresh my face. I work 10-16 hrs a day seven days a week. I have always loved Amazon brand but this is crappy one Honestly I just don't understand how I got an infection from it and how it messed up so bad

Cleans facial oil great but it leaves a bad smell. I asked my wife (the master arbiter for health and beauty aids) and she concurred. I poured that crap down the sink, rinsed out the container and refilled it with another brand.

avis.titre: Rip-off. Received leaky product and has no return/refund policy
avis.texte: I guess lower prices mean lower quality packaging and product. Item arrived with about 20% of the astringent missing. It has no return/refund policy although it’s “eligible for return”. TOTAL RIPOFF. Shell out a few more bucks and buy original brand.
Would not recommend. The seal was completely missing on one bottle and it had a totally different top. From reading other reviews, this seems to be a common problem.

avis.titre: Just as good as the expensive brands...
avis.texte: I’ve tried plenty of astringents ranging from very expensive to fairly cheap. My go to brand usually ran me about 10$ per bottle. I tend to use astringents for blemishes and it makes me face feel clean before bed. This is great. I was expecting the formula to seem weaker but it wasn’t. Cleaned just as well as other brands. The smell isn’t too strong (alcohol smell). Overall, when I run out of this I will be buying a new bottle because I like the way my face feels after I use it.
My wife reports that this works as well as the more expensive brand. Would definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Bottle was leaky! Good for the price.
avis.texte: I use toners every single night after washing and before moisturizing for the night. This one has a very strong medicinal smell. It also is very heavy on the alcohol for those with super dry skin, this isn't for you. I have sensitive skin so this burned my cheeks a bit. It did help mattify my oily forehead. I have dry combination skin, so this didn't work out for me 100% but if you have super oily skin, I feel you will like this. It does feel refreshing. I had problems with the bottle. It wouldn't close all the way, so it was leaky. I store it in a cabinet, so it wasn't much of a problem.
